dedupe_keys.name: multi platform satellite derived products during the 2025 etna eruption

description: Multi-platform satellite-derived products during the 2025 Etna eruption is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by G. Ganci et al. Earth Observation data are playing an increasingly central role in volcanology, enabling high-resolution assessments of the timing, magnitude, and explosivity of eruptive events. A suite of satellite-derived products is provided here, documenting the February 2025 eruption of Mt. Etna (Italy), the first eruption fully monitored also by the third-generation Meteosat satellite, providing unprecedented mid-infrared spatial and temporal resolution. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Excel, GeoTIFF, Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 38016194 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
